# within family

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:withinFamily`](gmeow-withinFamily.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/withinFamily>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/genealogy`](../../slices/genealogy.md)

Anchors a reified kinship relationship in the family group it belongs to — the structural seam GEDCOM exchange requires (a child's family, a marriage's family). Optional: kinship claims stand alone; the family anchor is added when the family-group structure is itself a documented fact (— consumers: the gedcom projection and the published genealogy profiles).
